cards.hypothesis: The frozen Qwen3.8-27B representation transfers better than Qwen3.5-9B for the same decision-head training recipe.
cards.targeted_change: Replace only backbone ID/revision and necessary input dimension; regenerate frozen feature cache.

success_criterion.primary: E4 fixed calibrated coverage-adjusted macro accuracy exceeds E3 by at least 0.01 absolute (1 percentage point).
success_criterion.interpretation: A smaller positive difference is a directional improvement below the practical success threshold; zero/negative rejects improvement for this seed. Confirm any practical gain across additional seeds before a robust claim.
diagnostics: training time and cache setup cost

cards.criterion_timing: Hypothesis and controlled change preregistered before launch; numerical practical threshold clarified now during feature extraction, before E4 train/test results.

cards.hypothesis: Bidirectional full-attention layers improve evidence/option binding and transfer compared with native causality.
cards.targeted_change: Remove causal masking in full-attention layers only; preserve padding isolation and native recurrent/convolution paths; regenerate cache.

success_criterion.primary: Fixed calibrated coverage-adjusted macro accuracy exceeds E4 by at least 0.01 absolute.
correctness_gates: CPU suffix visibility and padding isolation tests pass
real-cache future-suffix probe shows nonzero prefix effect
success_criterion.interpretation: A smaller gain is directional but below the practical threshold; degradation rejects the proposed benefit. Confirm a practical gain across additional seeds before a robust claim.

cards.criterion_timing: Recorded before E5 GPU setup or training.

cards.hypothesis: Training on explicit Boolean entailment views improves Boolean transfer beyond simply repeating the same human-labelled ANLI examples.
cards.targeted_change: Use 414 balanced human entailment/contradiction ANLI train-only rows as Noul views, versus equal-count original Choice replay. Neutral excluded. No new contexts or teacher labels.
cards.control: Matched Choice replay on the same 414 native IDs, with identical number of decisions and updates. Select identical backbone/attention context for both only after E4/E5; record that choice before launch.

success_criterion.primary: Noul-view condition exceeds matched replay fixed composite by at least 0.01 absolute.
success_criterion.mechanism: Original Noul dev-slice accuracy improves by at least 0.05 absolute versus matched replay.
success_criterion.interpretation: Meeting both supports the intended Boolean-transfer mechanism. Composite-only gain is useful but mechanism remains unconfirmed; slice-only gain without primary gain fails the overall objective. Confirm positive evidence across seeds.
diagnostics: RAGTruth/TabFact/TruthfulQA per-suite accuracy and prediction distributions

cards.criterion_timing: Recorded before either candidate training condition is launched.
